summary: Super Hi International Holding Ltd. filed a 6-K announcing the resignation of executive director Ms. Liu Li due to work adjustment and duty re-allocation, effective May 20, 2026, with no disagreement with the board, and the appointment of Ms. Jiang Bingyu as executive director effective the same date. Ms. Jiang, age 39, has over 15 years of restaurant operations experience, currently serves as Canadian regional manager, and led the establishment of eight Haidilao hotpot restaurants in Canada. No price, premium, or financial terms are involved. This is a routine board-level change with no special situation beyond management departure.
